name: Chimpanzee
description: A peaceful plant-eater. A chimp won't fight unless it or its young are threatened.

name: Gorilla
description: A great ape.

name: Black Bear
description: A small, omnivorous bear.

name: Grizzly Bear
description:
When making reaction rolls for bears, remember that grizzly, polar, and cave bears are mostly carnivorous and ill-tempered. Any mother bear with cubs will be aggressive: -3 to reactions!

A bear walking or running on four legs is a two-hex creature. When it stands on its hind legs to fight, it is a one-hex creature.

name: Polar Bear
description:

name: Cave Bear
description: A prehistoric creature.

name: House Cat
description: A domestic feline, kept as a pet, familiar, or mouser.

name: Lion
description: A big, lazy cat, found in both plains and jungle. Lions hunt in small groups.

name: Tiger
description: A solitary hunting cat, usually a jungle dweller.

name: Red Deer
description: A large deer, common in medieval Europe and still widespread today.

name: Large Guard Dog
notes: a price is still in the text
description: Domesticated dogs are used for hunting or as pets (or, if large enough, as draft animals). There are many breeds; statistics can vary greatly. Cost ranges from negligible to $10,000+. A healthy, trained dog - even a mongrel - is always worth at least $200.

name: Large Falcon
description: These birds of prey are commonly used for sport hunting. A trained falcon - or one disturbed by a stranger - might attack a human. A diving falcon can reach Move 70!

name: Tiger Shark
description: A large, aggressive shark.

name: Great White Shark
description: An apex predator!

name: Python
description: A large constrictor. Statistics are for a 15' Indian python, but lengths can reach 30'!

name: Rattlesnake
description: A common poisonous snake. Even little ones are dangerous; the gigantic diamondback described here (8' long) is deadly. Modifiers to HT roll for venom: +1 if venom is immediately sucked out; +2 if antivenin (TL6+) is used.

name: Large Boar
description: Wild hogs are hunted for food - but they're dangerous game. Boars are smart, evil-tempered, and likely to attack even when encountered by accident. They try to knock a man down with a slam and gore him while he's down. Sows are less aggressive and smaller (give them lower ST and weight).

name: Small Boar
description: A javelina or peccary.

name: Timber Wolf
description: These wild carnivores hunt in packs. They can be domesticated, more or less, but never like a dog.

name: Camel
description: A dry-plains native, the camel can go for four days without drinking. Its stubborn temper gives -4 to Animal Handling rolls.

name: Cavalry Horse
description: A light warhorse.

name: Donkey

name: Strix
description:
A strix (plural striges) is a bloodsucking, birdlike creature about the size of a crow, with a long beak and large eyes. Striges are nocturnal. A strix attacks with its long, barbed beak. If the attack penetrates armor, the strix sucks its victim's blood.

Striges have excellent aim, and can even attack through the eyeslits of a helm. Only two striges can strike thus in a second, but a successful hit can also blind the eye!
